project.premise: In one stormy night, a lighthouse keeper receives a letter in her own handwriting that predicts the lamp will fail before dawn unless she admits the truth she has hidden from her apprentice.
project.setting: A one-lamp island light station off a cold coast: the lantern room, the oil store, the winding stair, and a cottage the sea spray never quite leaves alone. Everything the keeper owns is logged, salted, or rusting.

arcs.description: Tell a complete short story in one compact arc: Mara receives the impossible warning, investigates the lantern room with Tomas, confesses that she ignored an earlier safety fault, and chooses to repair the light before dawn rather than preserve her pride.

threads.description: Who wrote the warning letter in Mara's handwriting?
Whether Mara will admit she concealed the cracked lens bracket before it endangers a ship.

characters.name: Mara Vane
characters.description: The island's meticulous lighthouse keeper; proud of her competence and frightened that one mistake will define her.

characters.name: Tomas Reed
characters.description: Mara's young apprentice; observant, loyal, and unwilling to let reverence stop him from asking hard questions.
